text: Addendum No. 1 dated August 26, 2026: from October 8, 2026, the unit price of Black Laser Printer Toner is changed to IDR 842,400.00 per unit.
Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
The Buyer pays a complete and correct invoice within 30 calendar days of the invoice date.
Payment is made by transfer to the Supplier's account at Bank CIMB Niaga, number 800114673900, in the name of Java Office Furnishings.
Late payment accrues interest of 1% per month on the overdue amount.
